title: Electrical Properties of Membranes and Membrane Potential
method: Whitespace-delimited visible paragraph words from theory and revision sections, excluding tables, figures, questions and references. Article words include headings, practice, captions, tables and references; exclude SVG and zoom button text.

Recomputed numerical results and audited original figures, including corrected I–V zero crossings. Original practice, not past papers. Textbook sources: Alberts, Purves, Hille and Goldman/Hodgkin/Katz/Huxley classical studies.
